headline: Ticketmaster posted an all-clear at 12:34 AM ET Saturday. It gave no cause, and there's still no sign of a hack.
summary: 2 new sources: s017, Ticketmaster Fan Support's own post on X (Tier 4, read directly), and s018, TicketNews's Nov 21 roundup (Tier 2). headline: The Friday outage also held up entry at a football final in Melbourne, where officials called it global. Still no cause, no sign of a hack.
summary: 1 new Tier 2 source (s016, The Age). The 1:05 PM AEDT start is 9:05 PM ET Friday, the same hours as the Superdome; new timeline row t010. Same report runs in the SMH and Brisbane Times (one publisher), so counted once. c011 rechecked: The Age gives no cause either. headline: Ticketmaster has not said what caused its Nov 20 outage. Nobody has claimed or reported a hack.
summary: First draft. 9 sources (1 Tier 1, 7 Tier 2, 1 Tier 3), 15 claims (2 Confirmed, 9 Reported, 1 Rumor, 3 Not established), 7 questions. The Friday outage at the Caesars Superdome is Confirmed by the organizer's and the venue manager's own statements. Whether it was a cyberattack is Not established: no cause, no claim, no statement either way. An anonymous 'probing' comment is carried as a Rumor with no evidence. The Nov 19 South Dakota disruption rests on one outlet. The brief's 'mostly fixed by about 10 PM ET' became about 10:30 PM ET because the venue's times are Central.
